desc: Read H, W, grid F, Q, and queries.
Build edges between orthogonal neighbors with weight = min(F[u], F[v]) and collect all edges.
Sort edges descending and use DSU to construct the maximum spanning tree adjacency list.
Run iterative DFS from node 0 to compute parent, depth, and weight_to_parent for each node.
Precompute binary lifting tables up[k][v] and min_up[k][v] (k up to LOG ~ 19 for N=250000).
For each query, find M as the minimum edge weight on the tree path between (A,B) and (C,D) using LCA and min aggregation.
Compute answer: if M >= min(Y,Z) then |Y-Z| else Y+Z-2*M, then print.
Verify with the provided sample input and ensure no recursion depth issues (use sys.setrecursionlimit or iterative loops).
